"""Invalid-request test suite: every case must yield {"status":"invalid"}."""
import copy, json, subprocess, sys

BASE = {"epoch":7,"node_count":2,
        "edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4}],
        "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[0],[1]],"previous":[16,0]}],
        "failed_edges":[],"budget":1}

def mut(**kw):
    r = copy.deepcopy(BASE); r.update(kw); return r

cases = []
def add(name, obj_or_text):
    cases.append((name, obj_or_text))

add("not json", "not JSON")
add("blank", "")
add("whitespace only", "   \t  ")
add("array", "[1,2,3]")
add("number", "42")
add("string", '"hello"')
add("null", "null")
add("trailing garbage", '{"epoch":7} trailing')
add("dup key", '{"epoch":7,"epoch":8,"node_count":2,"edges":[],"commodities":[],"failed_edges":[],"budget":1}')
add("missing key", '{"epoch":7,"node_count":2,"edges":[],"commodities":[],"failed_edges":[]}')
add("unknown key", mut(extra=1))
add("epoch negative", mut(epoch=-1))
add("epoch too big", mut(epoch=2147483648))
add("epoch float", mut(epoch=7.0))
add("epoch bool", mut(epoch=True))
add("epoch string", mut(epoch="7"))
add("node_count 0", mut(node_count=0))
add("node_count 97", mut(node_count=97))
add("node_count float", mut(node_count=2.5))
add("node_count bool", mut(node_count=True))
add("edges not list", mut(edges={}))
add("edges 385", mut(edges=[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4}]*385))
add("edge extra key", mut(edges=[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4,"x":1}]))
add("edge missing key", mut(edges=[{"tail":0,"head":1}]))
add("edge self loop", mut(edges=[{"tail":0,"head":0,"capacity":4}]))
add("edge node out of range", mut(edges=[{"tail":0,"head":2,"capacity":4}]))
add("edge negative node", mut(edges=[{"tail":-1,"head":1,"capacity":4}]))
add("edge cap 0", mut(edges=[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":0}]))
add("edge cap 1025", mut(edges=[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":1025}]))
add("edge cap float", mut(edges=[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4.5}]))
add("edge tail float", mut(edges=[{"tail":0.0,"head":1,"capacity":4}]))
add("edge not dict", mut(edges=[[0,1,4]]))
add("commodities 97", mut(commodities=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":0,"paths":[],"previous":[]}]*97))
add("com extra key", mut(commodities=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16],"z":1}]))
add("com same src tgt", mut(commodities=[{"source":0,"target":0,"demand":4,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]}]))
add("demand 1025", mut(commodities=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":1025,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]}]))
add("demand negative", mut(commodities=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":-1,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]}]))
add("demand float", mut(commodities=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":1.5,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]}]))
add("paths not list", mut(commodities=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":0,"previous":[]}]))
add("paths 17", mut(commodities=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[0]]*17,"previous":[0]*17}]))
add("path empty", mut(commodities=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[]],"previous":[16]}]))
add("path edge out of range", mut(commodities=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[2]],"previous":[16]}]))
add("path negative edge", mut(commodities=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[-1]],"previous":[16]}]))
add("path discontinuous", mut(commodities=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[0,1]],"previous":[16]}]))
add("path wrong source", mut(commodities=[{"source":1,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]}]))
add("path wrong target", mut(commodities=[{"source":0,"target":0,"demand":4,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]}]))
add("duplicate path", mut(commodities=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[0],[0]],"previous":[8,8]}]))
add("previous mismatch len", mut(commodities=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[0],[1]],"previous":[16]}]))
add("previous sum not 16", mut(commodities=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[0],[1]],"previous":[15,0]}]))
add("previous entry 17", mut(commodities=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[0],[1]],"previous":[17,-1]}]))
add("previous float", mut(commodities=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16.0]}]))
add("previous not list", mut(commodities=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[0]],"previous":16}]))
add("zero demand bad path", mut(commodities=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":0,"paths":[[0,1]],"previous":[16]}]))
add("failed path malformed", mut(commodities=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[0,1]],"previous":[16]}], failed_edges=[0]))
add("failed edge out of range", mut(failed_edges=[5]))
add("failed edge negative", mut(failed_edges=[-1]))
add("failed edge duplicate", mut(failed_edges=[0,0]))
add("failed edges not list", mut(failed_edges=0))
add("budget 98305", mut(budget=98305))
add("budget negative", mut(budget=-1))
add("budget float", mut(budget=1.0))
add("budget bool", mut(budget=False))
add("nan value", '{"epoch":7,"node_count":2,"edges":[],"commodities":[],"failed_edges":[],"budget":NaN}')
add("infinity value", '{"epoch":7,"node_count":2,"edges":[],"commodities":[],"failed_edges":[],"budget":Infinity}')
add("top-level list", "[{\"epoch\":7}]")

# valid controls
good = []
def addgood(name, obj): good.append((name, obj))
addgood("base", BASE)
addgood("empty everything", {"epoch":0,"node_count":1,"edges":[],"commodities":[],"failed_edges":[],"budget":0})
addgood("no commodities", {"epoch":1,"node_count":3,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":5}],"commodities":[],"failed_edges":[],"budget":0})
addgood("demand no paths (infeasible)", {"epoch":2,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":5}],"commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":3,"paths":[],"previous":[]}],"failed_edges":[],"budget":0})
addgood("zero demand with paths", {"epoch":3,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":5}],"commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":0,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]}],"failed_edges":[],"budget":0})
addgood("failed path all", {"epoch":4,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":5}],"commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":3,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]}],"failed_edges":[0],"budget":0})
addgood("whitespace padded", "  " + json.dumps(BASE) + "  \n")
addgood("16 paths", {"epoch":5,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":5}],"commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":3,"paths":[[0]]*16,"previous":[1]*16}],"failed_edges":[],"budget":0})

lines = []
expect = []
for name, obj in cases:
    if isinstance(obj, str):
        lines.append(obj)
    else:
        lines.append(json.dumps(obj))
    expect.append("invalid")
for name, obj in good:
    lines.append(obj if isinstance(obj, str) else json.dumps(obj))
    expect.append("valid")

data = ("\n".join(lines) + "\n").encode()
proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/app/submission/planner.py"], input=data, capture_output=True, timeout=300)
out = proc.stdout.decode().splitlines()
print("rc", proc.returncode, "lines", len(out), "expected", len(lines))
if proc.stderr: print("stderr:", proc.stderr.decode()[-2000:])
bad = 0
for i, (name, exp) in enumerate(zip([c[0] for c in cases] + [g[0] for g in good], expect)):
    if i >= len(out):
        print("MISSING", name); bad += 1; continue
    resp = json.loads(out[i])
    if exp == "invalid":
        if resp != {"status": "invalid"}:
            print("EXPECTED invalid:", name, "->", out[i][:200]); bad += 1
    else:
        if resp.get("status") == "invalid":
            print("EXPECTED valid:", name, "->", out[i][:200]); bad += 1
        else:
            print("ok(%s): %s" % (name, out[i][:110]))
print("bad =", bad)
PYEOF
